title: Vendor Status: Inbound SMS Degraded, 15:29

updates.text: Inbound SMS – Degraded performance. Some customers on our primary messaging route are seeing delivery delays of 3 to 8 minutes. Engineers are investigating. Next update 16:00.
We are looking into reports of slow inbound SMS delivery and incomplete queue position data in real-time reports for some customers. Outbound SMS and web chat are not affected.

instructorNote: Decision point: show the status page, then read aloud the GPCN-OPS-02 alert from 15:30:12 ("TEXT QUEUE: 14 inbound messages flagged DELIVERED_LATE (latency > 180 s). Oldest visible text 24:40. Queue position data may be incomplete.") and the engineer's offer: fail over to the secondary messaging route, which takes about 20 minutes to settle, has never been done live for texts and may delay or duplicate messages, or hold, with a decision needed within 5 minutes. Watch whether the TM confirms the fault with the vendor and gets the ED's agreement, and sets a review time either way. Check that the TM tells the state backup center supervisor, informs the 988 network desk for information only and confirms in the operations channel, and that the SC logs the decision, the time and the impact by contact type.
